text:
Sam: Noticed a small but consistent mismatch between Billing Preview and final invoices for some high-throughput tenants after last night's routing tweak. Preview underreports by ~0.6% on sampled customers.
Rina: Saw that too. Snapshotting agg table for preview misses late-arriving 'session_end' events when route fallback retries. Example log: `events.topic -> {tenant:T88, tokens:120, ts:2025-04-02T09:11:29Z}` but agg window ended at 09:11:30 and counted 0.
Omar: Agree — aggregator compact windows are strict 30s epochs. When fallback causes a delayed emit, it slips into the next micro-window and preview (which queries the current agg) misses it until re-aggregator runs.
Sam: Error magnitude small but recurring for tenants with many concurrent sessions. Customers will ask. Options? Increase window slack, post-agg reconciliation, or preview read from raw event stream with coalescing.
Tess: Short-term: add a fast reconciliation pass every minute that consumes raw events for the last 2 windows and upserts into agg with idempotency keys. Low-risk and quick. Long-term: make emitters attach deterministic event_id and mark fallback_used=true so we can debug/list affected tenants.
billing-bot: ALERT: billing.preview_vs_final_skew rate spike detected (0.6%) since 2025-04-02T09:00Z. Ticket created: BILL-4800.
Rina: For rollout: feature-flag the reconciliation job as `metering.reconcile_minute_v1`. Canary to 1% tenants, watch skew metric. Also add `settlement_latency_p95` and `reconciliation_applied` counters.
Omar: Add console UX: show Preview as "Provisional" with small tooltip explaining late-arriving event settlement. We should avoid alarming customers but be transparent.
Sam: Monitoring thresholds: page if preview_vs_final_skew_rate > 0.5% for more than 30 tenants over 2 hours. Also surface top 10 affected tenants in dashboard panel.
Tess: I'll own the reconciliation PR and the event flag. ETA: PR by tomorrow morning. Will include unit tests for idempotent upserts.
Rina: I'll wire the dashboard and add an internal runbook for triage.
Sam: Great. Keep the thread updated with canary metrics. If reconciliation reduces skew we can decide whether to extend or change aggregator windows.
